name: comp-125
blurb: Image upload button with preview thumbnail and remove control.
description: Single-image uploader with a small preview icon and button. Shows file name and offers removal. Built on useFileUpload hook.
use_when: Profile avatar or product image uploads where one image at a time is expected.
avoid_when: Bulk uploads; use multi-file variants instead.
a11y: Input is sr-only with proper labels. Buttons and regions marked for live updates.
